overview: In MEA's price-competitive mobile markets subscribers leave over tariff, coverage and unresolved complaints — and the standard defence, discounting broadly, spends margin on people who were never going to go. Subscriber Churn Prediction & Retention Next-Best-Offer scores churn risk from usage decline, plan mismatch and care history, then pairs each at-risk subscriber with the retention offer they are most likely to accept, delivered to care agents and campaign systems. Retention costs roughly a fifth of acquisition, so the case rests on targeting rather than volume. Four to five weeks on the operator's own CDR and billing data tests that against a measured churn baseline.
